name: openbb_insider_trading
description:
Insider (officer, director, 10% owner) transactions from SEC Form 4 data through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.ownership.insider_trading).
Returns: {symbol, transactions: [records with filing and transaction dates, owner name and title, transaction type, shares, price, shares owned after]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (when omitted the tool asks for 20, the schema says 5); provider (fmp, intrinio or sec; default fmp; sec needs no key).
Other sources: yf_insider_transactions, edgar_insider_transactions. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "TSLA", "limit": 10, "provider": "sec"}
